subject: Taxes
title: John Doe Summons Expansion
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: John Doe Summons Expansion.

hook.text: After Coinbase, the IRS issued John Doe summons to Kraken, Circle, and Poloniex.

buildup.text: A John Doe summons demands records of unnamed taxpayers matching a profile.

discovery.text: By 2023, the IRS had data from multiple exchanges covering millions of users.

twist.text: Users who moved to decentralized exchanges to avoid reporting may still be caught.

climax.text: The IRS strategy is clear: collect data from every exchange, match it to tax returns, and pursue the gaps.

punchline.text: Summons after summons. The IRS is building a complete map of US crypto users.

quiz.question: What is a John Doe summons?
options: A demand for records of unnamed taxpayers matching a profile
